craft_notes: Sthāyin: daily-made (single-line sūtra). Rows: row 1 (whole — never split a two-word-adjacent? kept whole). Close: practice (abhyāsa as landing). Rejected: expanding to couplet — kept single (the verse's brevity IS the point).

lines: Even of the liberation-seeker, made-of-That attainment, of the living — daily, as sustained practice.
l4.sanskrit_cite: mumukṣor api tanmayībhāvasiddhaye ayam jīvataḥ pratyaham anuṣṭhānābhyāsavat

reads_against.argmap: And the living? → Even the liberation-seeker practices daily, like sustained observance, toward made-of-That-ness.
c1_essence: Even the liberation-seeker's made-of-That attainment, of the living, daily, like sustained practice.
